Why You Should Train to Be Ethically Fit

Think of great athletes; they are fit in a way that relies on years of training and practice. An accomplished track star did not suddenly decide to run the four-minute mile one morning and have all the skills, strength, and endurance to do it. Elite tennis players prepare for and anticipate mid-game scenarios and know just what shot to draw on because they’ve practiced it thousands of times.
